description: The Colombian university research team publishes HAGDAVS, combining drone RGB orthomosaics with digital-surface-model information for vehicle detection. The archive provides original imagery, a height-augmented image representation, class masks and geolocated vehicle bounding boxes. Cars, motorcycles and ghost vehicles caused by moving objects in mosaics are distinguished. TIFF and GeoJSON products are available from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. These study-area observations can improve traffic or parking measurements used in infrastructure simulations and digital twins. Orthomosaic artefacts and occlusion remain important limitations; the short repository metadata does not establish complete regional sampling. Archive contents and classification quality were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
